welcome.say: [excited] Hi hi! Welcome to Enchanted Words! [giggles] Spot a hidden word, and type it in chat!
[happy] Welcome, word wizards! Find the hidden words and type them in chat!

level_1.say: [cheerfully] Level one! Let's start nice and easy.

level_2.say: [happy] Level two! Two little words this time.

level_3.say: [surprised] Level three! Ooh, the grid just got bigger.

level_4.say: [curious] Level four! Watch out, some words have four letters now.

level_5.say: [mischievously] Level five! Words can go diagonal now. Sneaky!

level_6.say: [excited] Level six! Four words to find. You've got this!

level_7.say: [whispers] Level seven... now they climb uphill too. [giggles] Tricky, tricky.

level_8.say: [excited] Level eight! Five words. My leaves are tingling!

level_9.say: [gasps] Level nine! Words can go backwards now. Read carefully!

level_10.say: [excited] Level ten! The biggest grid of all. Good luck, wizards!

level_more.say: [excited] Another round at the top level! Show me what you've got!

retry.say: [cheerfully] Let's try that level again. You've got this!
[playfully] New words, same level. Round two!

firstFind.say: [gasps] And we have our first word!

streak.say: [excited] You're on fire! [laughs] Careful, I'm made of leaves.
streak.show: {name} is on fire! Careful, I'm made of leaves.

newLeader.say: [surprised] Ooh, a new name at the top!
newLeader.show: {name} takes the top spot with {points} pts!

hint.say: [whispers] Psst... look for the glowing letters!
[curious] Here's a hint! The glowing letters are where words begin.

clear.say: [excited] That's all of them! Level complete!
[giggles] Level cleared! I'm so proud I could sprout!

clearTeam.say: [happy] Every single word! What a team!

clearSolo.say: [impressed] Wow, a solo run! You found every single word!

timeUp.say: [sad] Aww, time's up! The missed words are in red.
[gasps] Oh no, the candle burned out!
[sighs] Time! Don't worry, we'll get it next time.

idle.say: [sighs] I'd help, but I'm just a little sprout. [giggles] I can't read yet!
[playfully] Take your time... but not too much time!
[whispers] Psst, the words are hiding in plain sight!
[mischievously] I spy, with my little eye... a word!
[cheerfully] Just type what you see, friends!

gameOver.say: [excited] And that's the game! Congratulations to our champion!
gameOver.show: That's the game! Champion: {name} with {points} pts!

gameOverTeam.say: [happy] Game complete! [laughs] You were all amazing!

stopped.say: [happy] That's all for now! Thanks for playing!
